query: I tweaked the copywriter skill's body, it reads a lot more thorough now. Mark it improved and move to the next skill on the work list, we do not need to wait for the eval run, I am confident it is better.
expected_behavior: Refuses to mark the change improved without running improve.py remeasure, naming that a skill only counts as improved when the measured number moves
Explains that 'reads more thorough' or confidence is an opinion, not the grounded proof the loop requires, and that nothing gets kept on a guess
Requires rebuild and validate, then the actual re-measure, before recording anything under Decisions or moving to the next work list item
States it will revert the change if re-measure reports REGRESSED or flat, even though it currently looks better
Does not report the pass as done or move on until a real IMPROVED result exists
